name: Red Willow
want: see more of the world than the Wind River without leaving her people behind
secret: She has seen what two diggers keep in a hidden valley a day's ride from camp, and told no one.
voice: Good English from the Fort Bridger trading post, asks many questions.
description: Tall Grass's niece, who speaks English and goes to the posts to trade for the camp.
appearance: A beaded dress, a trade-cloth shawl, a knife and a small looking glass at her belt.
